title: UoT-UWF-PartAI at SemEval-2021 Task 5: Self Attention Based Bi-GRU with Multi-Embedding Representation for Toxicity Highlighter
reasoning: The paper describes a machine learning architecture for detecting toxic spans in text as part of a shared task competition. Its focus is entirely on performance metrics (F1 score) and technical model components (Bi-GRU, embeddings like GPT-2 and RoBERTa, and self-attention) rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical considerations.
